source.source_text: 1974: Born in Los Angeles, California | 1991: Debut in Critters 3 | 1993: Played Tobias Wolff in 'This Boy's Life' | 1993: Received critical acclaim and first Academy Award nomination for 'What's Eating Gilbert Grape' | 1993: Won National Board of Review Award | 1995: Star in The Quick and the Dead | 1996: Star in Romeo + Juliet | 1997: International stardom with Titanic. | 1997: Star in Titanic | 1998: Brief featured role in Woody Allen's Celebrity | 1998: Established the Leonardo DiCaprio Foundation in 1998. | 1999: Won a Golden Raspberry Award for Worst Screen Couple | 2000: Debut in Titanic | 2002: Received third Golden Globe nomination for performance in Catch Me If You Can
